newsitem.title: USA: M/I Schottenstein buys shares from family.
newsitem.headline: M/I Schottenstein buys shares from family.

text.p: M/I Schottenstein Homes Inc on Monday said it has repurchased 500,000 shares of company stock from the Melvin Schottenstein family interests.
The repurchase was completed at the Friday, March 14, 1997 market closing price of $10.50 per share. The shares will be held as treasury shares by the company.

The company said that after the repurchase, the Irving Schottenstein family holdings, which includes those of M/I's chief executive officer, president and senior executive vice president, will control 33 percent of the company's outstanding shares.
The Melvin Schottenstein family holdings will be reduced to 24 percent of the shares outstanding.
In conjunction with this stock transaction, Lenore Sagner has resigned from the Board of Directors, and will be replaced by Amy Schottenstein.
